scope: Independent CPU execution of attributed official Wan2.2 model equations; not CUDA numerical parity or an original model
upstream_provenance_meaning: upstream-provenance.json is an exact copied record whose relative paths describe the upstream package. They are not assertions that this package's custom vendor/attention.py is upstream code.
custom_attention_meaning: Original compatibility code implementing explicitly declared CPU BF16 SDPA, separately source-hashed by CPU and runtime reports
runtime_translation: Seven official CUDA autocast calls are changed to disabled CPU autocast calls. A reversible AST comparison verifies that no other AST nodes change. Original source and translated text are retained separately.
parameter_path: Original FP32 values, official convert_model_dtype=False semantics, outer CPU BF16 autocast with weight caching disabled; one module loaded and evicted at a time
